description: Time builds strength, wisdom and understanding. Patience is not an act of weakness but a sweet virtue #quantumleap #DesignYourLife #designyourlife
transcript: Time reminds me that I'm sharper and I'm wiser because of it. There have been moments where I was stuck in time and I was frozen and I couldn't move and those moments that is where I build strength, where I build resilience, where I build understanding and those are the things that have brought me to this arrival. Time was never against me. Time was there to form me, to shape me, to prepare me and now I'm able to appreciate it and sit in it and bask in this present moment because I understand that it's bleeding and it's easy to waste.
